fieldNotes.truckGate: Street View (pano 8WBC_aXzo6AEPR4bJWP_Qg, heading ~280deg) shows a chain-link sliding gate across the truck drive at the NE/east entrance, perimeter fencing, a 'TRUCK ENTRANCE' sign and a stone Publix monument. Open campus-road approach, but a controlled gate at the fence line.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth (1-3 car footprint) visible at the gate in any Street View heading; only slim pole-mounted pedestals (kiosk / call-box) flank the lanes.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Inferred remote check-in: gate present, no guard shack, kiosk/call-box pedestals at the lanes. Medium confidence on whether check-in is fully unmanned vs. occasionally staffed.
fieldNotes.entryExitSeparate: Entrance drive is divided by a landscaped median into distinct inbound and outbound lanes at the gate.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide divided gate apron with unused paved width before the gate; room to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Cross-dock: dock banks with trailers backed in along the north/NE, west/SW and south faces. Counted ~80-120+ doors across faces from z18 imagery; reported band 50+. Exact count is an overhead estimate.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Two large trailer drop lots (SW lot by the pond and the east apron) holding dozens of parked trailers without tractors.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Distinct dock clusters on different building faces (north/NE bank vs. south/west bank), consistent with separate ship/receive operations at a refrigerated cross-dock.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town McCalla AL inside Jefferson Metropolitan Park, surrounded by woods/farmland and a few industrial neighbors; broader setting is rural.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs NW-SE through the trees off the west property edge but does not spur into the site; no rail dock on the property.
fieldNotes.yardMetrics: dockDoorCount/trailersVisible/trailerParkingCapacity are overhead estimates from z17-z18 satellite, flagged as approximate.
